 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The final match of the NWSL quarterfinals is set to be a blockbuster, with the Washington Spirit hosting the Portland Thorns on Sunday, Nov. 8.
 The Spirit earned the right to host the match at Audi Field by finishing third in the regular season standings. Portland came in sixth place, five points back of the home side.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The game will see two of the league's biggest stars face off, with Trinity Rodman leading the Spirit against her USWNT teammate Sophia Wilson and the Thorns.
 USA TODAY Sports will be live at Audi Field providing all the updates from the match.
 How to watch Washington Spirit vs. Portland Thorns
 When:  Sunday, November 8
 Where: Audi Field (Washington, D.C.)
 Time:  3 p.m. ET
 Channel/streaming:  ABC, ESPN Deportes (Watch HERE )
